subject.title: feat(ui): scroll truncated sidebar session names on hover

question: After the stale row-state bug is fixed, should OpenClaw accept automatic hover scrolling for truncated Control UI sidebar session names?
rationale: This is a new visible hover interaction on a protected-label PR, so correctness of the code path does not settle the product interaction choice.

options.title: Accept after stale-state fix
options.body: Merge the focused hover-marquee behavior after row reuse is made safe and exact-head checks stay clean.

options.title: Keep static ellipsis
options.body: Decline the feature if maintainers prefer the current static label plus native title tooltip behavior.

options.title: Request a different affordance
options.body: Ask for a tooltip, popover, or broader sidebar-title design if automatic scrolling is not the desired interaction.

recommendation.title: Accept after stale-state fix
recommendation.body: Merge the focused hover-marquee behavior after row reuse is made safe and exact-head checks stay clean.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has prior Control UI overflow/sidebar history and is the best available product-routing owner among the likely owners.
